data.name: p281-novel-a
data.yaml_source:
# Capability trial A — can this stack run a novel-shaped workflow?
#
# Shape taken from the France Novel design (Notion): roles split across vendors, an immutable
# draft that every reviewer judges, required reviews plus an advisory Cold Reader, a deterministic
# triage that owns the graph edge, and a bounded repair loop. Nothing of that project is imported:
# the entry state is a fixture written for this trial.
#
# What is being tried out here, and has never run in this stack before:
#   * a real Conductor `parallel` group (three reviewers at once, continue_on_error)
#   * three different vendors inside one run, each on its own login
#   * a deterministic step choosing PASS / REPAIR from files the models wrote
#
#   conductor run p281/workflows/novel-a.yaml -i profile=research-default
workflow:
  name: p281-novel-a
  description: Role-split chapter with parallel reviews and bounded repair (capability trial)
  entry_point: route
  input:
    profile:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: research-default
      description: execution profile (config/profiles/<name>.yaml)
    max_repairs:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: "1"
      description: how many repair rounds are allowed before the chapter is blocked
  limits:
    max_iterations: 30
    timeout_seconds: 3000

agents:
  # Quota still decides whether anything may run at all.
  - name: route
    type: script
    description: Quota admission (the roles below are bound by design, not by the router)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/route.py", "{{ workflow.input.profile }}"]
    output:
      decision: {type: string}
      provider: {type: string}
      reason: {type: string}
      profile: {type: string}
      evidence_dir: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: roles
        when: "{{ route.output.decision == 'ROUTE' }}"
      - to: record_hold

  - name: roles
    type: script
    description: Bind each role to its vendor, with that vendor's login and route
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/roles.py", "{{ route.output.profile }}",
           "architect=codex", "author=claude", "story=codex", "history=claude", "cold=grok"]
    output:
      ok: {type: string}
      missing: {type: string}
      architect_provider: {type: string}
      architect_login: {type: string}
      architect_route: {type: string}
      author_provider: {type: string}
      author_login: {type: string}
      author_route: {type: string}
      story_provider: {type: string}
      story_login: {type: string}
      story_route: {type: string}
      history_provider: {type: string}
      history_login: {type: string}
      history_route: {type: string}
      cold_provider: {type: string}
      cold_login: {type: string}
      cold_route: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: stage
        when: "{{ roles.output.ok == 'yes' }}"
      - to: record_hold

  - name: stage
    type: script
    description: Put the fixture entry state in the run's workspace
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/novel_stage.py", "stage"]
    output:
      status: {type: string}
      workspace: {type: string}
      staged: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: architect

  - name: architect
    type: script
    description: Chapter contract (no prose)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/agent_task.py", "{{ roles.output.architect_provider }}",
           "{{ roles.output.architect_route }}", "architect",
           "/work/p281/prompts/novel-architect.md", "contract.json",
           "{{ route.output.profile }}", "{{ roles.output.architect_login }}"]
    timeout: 600
    output:
      status: {type: string}
      produced: {type: boolean}
      provider: {type: string}
      run_id: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: author
        when: "{{ architect.output.produced == true }}"
      - to: record_block

  - name: author
    type: script
    description: Prose — only this role writes prose
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/agent_task.py", "{{ roles.output.author_provider }}",
           "{{ roles.output.author_route }}", "author",
           "/work/p281/prompts/novel-author.md", "draft.md",
           "{{ route.output.profile }}", "{{ roles.output.author_login }}"]
    timeout: 900
    output:
      status: {type: string}
      produced: {type: boolean}
      provider: {type: string}
      run_id: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: freeze
        when: "{{ author.output.produced == true }}"
      - to: record_block

  - name: freeze
    type: script
    description: Fix the draft (id + sha256) so every reviewer judges the same artifact
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/novel_stage.py", "freeze"]
    output:
      status: {type: string}
      draft_id: {type: string}
      draft_sha256: {type: string}
      chars: {type: number}
    routes:
      - to: reviews

  # ---- the reviewers run at the same time, inside one step ----
  # Conductor's own `parallel` / `for_each` groups refuse script steps (v0.1.37), and every routed
  # model call here is a script step. So the fan-out lives in the step: see steps/novel_reviews.py.
  - name: reviews
    type: script
    description: Story + history (required) and Cold Reader (advisory), started together
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/novel_reviews.py", "{{ route.output.profile }}",
           "review-story:{{ roles.output.story_provider }}:{{ roles.output.story_login }}:{{ roles.output.story_route }}:/work/p281/prompts/novel-review-story.md:review_story.json:required",
           "review-history:{{ roles.output.history_provider }}:{{ roles.output.history_login }}:{{ roles.output.history_route }}:/work/p281/prompts/novel-review-history.md:review_history.json:required",
           "review-cold:{{ roles.output.cold_provider }}:{{ roles.output.cold_login }}:{{ roles.output.cold_route }}:/work/p281/prompts/novel-cold.md:review_cold.json:advisory"]
    timeout: 900
    output:
      status: {type: string}
      reviewers: {type: number}
      required_usable: {type: number}
      failed: {type: string}
      wall_s: {type: number}
      sum_of_steps_s: {type: number}
      longest_step_s: {type: number}
      concurrency: {type: number}
      detail: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: triage

  - name: triage
    type: script
    description: Deterministic routing decision from what the reviewers wrote
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/novel_stage.py", "triage", "{{ workflow.input.max_repairs }}"]
    output:
      decision: {type: string}
      reason: {type: string}
      repairs_done: {type: number}
      blocking_count: {type: number}
      cold_available: {type: string}
      cold_continue_reading: {type: string}
      draft_id: {type: string}
      draft_sha256: {type: string}
      chars: {type: number}
    routes:
      - to: repair
        when: "{{ triage.output.decision == 'REPAIR' }}"
      - to: record_pass
        when: "{{ triage.output.decision == 'PASS' }}"
      - to: record_block

  - name: repair
    type: script
    description: Repair — the same Author, fixing exactly the findings
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/agent_task.py", "{{ roles.output.author_provider }}",
           "{{ roles.output.author_route }}", "repair",
           "/work/p281/prompts/novel-author.md", "draft.md",
           "{{ route.output.profile }}", "{{ roles.output.author_login }}"]
    timeout: 900
    output:
      status: {type: string}
      produced: {type: boolean}
    routes:
      - to: freeze

  - name: record_pass
    type: script
    description: Record the run (never fails the workflow)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/record.py"]
    stdin: "{{ {'execute': {'provider': roles.output.author_provider, 'model_route': roles.output.author_route, 'run_id': triage.output.draft_id, 'status': 'COMPLETED'}, 'check': {'decision': triage.output.decision, 'reason': triage.output.reason}, 'route': route.output} | tojson }}"
    output:
      mlflow_run_id: {type: string}
      experiment_id: {type: string}
      record_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: done_pass

  - name: record_block
    type: script
    description: Record a blocked run
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/record.py"]
    stdin: "{{ {'check': {'decision': 'BLOCK', 'reason': 'novel-a blocked'}, 'route': route.output} | tojson }}"
    output:
      mlflow_run_id: {type: string}
      experiment_id: {type: string}
      record_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: done_block

  - name: record_hold
    type: script
    description: Record a run the router held
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/record.py"]
    stdin: "{{ {'route': route.output} | tojson }}"
    output:
      mlflow_run_id: {type: string}
      experiment_id: {type: string}
      record_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: done_hold

  - name: done_pass
    type: terminate
    status: success
    reason: "PASS: {{ triage.output.reason }} (draft {{ triage.output.draft_id }}, repairs {{ triage.output.repairs_done }})"

  - name: done_block
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "BLOCK: {{ triage.output.reason }}"

  - name: done_hold
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "HOLD: {{ route.output.reason }} {{ roles.output.missing }}"


output:
  profile: "{{ route.output.profile }}"
  route: "{{ route.output.decision }}: {{ route.output.reason }}"
  roles: "{% if roles is defined %}architect={{ roles.output.architect_provider }} author={{ roles.output.author_provider }} story={{ roles.output.story_provider }} history={{ roles.output.history_provider }} cold={{ roles.output.cold_provider }}{% endif %}"
  decision: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.decision }}{% endif %}"
  reason: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.reason }}{% endif %}"
  draft_id: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.draft_id }}{% endif %}"
  draft_sha256: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.draft_sha256 }}{% endif %}"
  chars: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.chars }}{% endif %}"
  repairs: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.repairs_done }}{% endif %}"
  cold_available: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.cold_available }}{% endif %}"
  cold_continue_reading: "{% if triage is defined %}{{ triage.output.cold_continue_reading }}{% endif %}"
  review_concurrency: "{% if reviews is defined %}{{ reviews.output.concurrency }}{% endif %}"
  review_wall_s: "{% if reviews is defined %}{{ reviews.output.wall_s }}{% endif %}"
  reviews_failed: "{% if reviews is defined %}{{ reviews.output.failed }}{% endif %}"
  mlflow_run_id: "{% if record_pass is defined %}{{ record_pass.output.mlflow_run_id }}{% elif record_block is defined %}{{ record_block.output.mlflow_run_id }}{% elif record_hold is defined %}{{ record_hold.output.mlflow_run_id }}{% endif %}"
  record_error: "{% if record_pass is defined %}{{ record_pass.output.record_error }}{% elif record_block is defined %}{{ record_block.output.record_error }}{% elif record_hold is defined %}{{ record_hold.output.record_error }}{% endif %}"
